data.name: Ridwaan
data.gender_notes: Ridwaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is content with the decree of Allah. The name Ridwaan carries the meaning “Favor, Blessing, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ridwaan usually hope their child will grow to embody favor, blessing, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ridwaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favor, Blessing, Satisfaction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ridwaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رضوان
in_arabic.meaning: رضوان يعني الرضا والقبول من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: رضوان هو اسم مشتق من الفعل رضي، والذي يعني الرضا والقبول. في القرآن الكريم، يأتي ذكر رضوان في سياق الرضا من الله تعالى على عباده. اسم رضوان يدل على معنى الرضا الإلهي والثواب الرباني، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: رضوان
in_urdu.meaning: رضوان مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا اور قبولیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضوان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو رضا اور قبولیت کے مفہوم سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے فعل 'رضي' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے راضی ہونا یا قبول کرنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، رضوان کا ذکر الہی رضا اور بندوں پر ربانی فضل کے تناظر میں کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: रिदवान
in_hindi.meaning: रिदवान का अर्थ है अल्लाह की رضा और क़ुबूलियत
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिदवान एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'رضي' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है संतुष्ट होना या स्वीकार करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, रिदवान का जिक्र दिव्य संतुष्टि और सेवकों पर ईश्वरीय आशीर्वाद के संदर्भ में किया गया है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पसंद किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: رضوان
in_pashto.meaning: رضوان د الله تعالی د رضا او قبول معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضوان داسې نوم دی چې د رضا او منلو د مفهوم سره تړلی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل 'رضي' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رضا یا قبول کولو څخه دي. په اسلامي کلتور کې، رضوان د الهي رضا او د بنده ګانو پر رباني فضل په تناظر کې ذکر شوی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Ridwaan
in_english.meaning: Means God's pleasure and acceptance in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Ridwaan is derived from the Arabic root 'rḍy', which means to be pleased or satisfied. In the Quran, Ridwaan refers to God's pleasure and acceptance of His servants. Historically, it signifies divine approval and favor. The name Ridwaan is cherished across Muslim cultures for its spiritual connotations and is often chosen for its positive implications on a child's character and destiny

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: رضوان
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رضوان

data.cultural_impact: The name Ridwaan holds significant cultural impact in the Islamic world as it represents contentment and pleasure from Allah's decree. In Islamic tradition, contentment with Allah's will is considered a noble characteristic, and a desirable state that expresses belief in Allah's wisdom and justice. The name Ridwaan serves as a constant reminder of this important virtue and reflects the desire for a deep connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: Similarly, from a spiritual perspective, the name Ridwaan carries profound significance as it represents a state of serene happiness and satisfaction that comes from being in harmony with Allah's will. This is a state of spiritual maturity, where one accepts the trials and tribulations of life as decreed by Allah, and finds peace and tranquility in submission to His will. The name Ridwaan is thus a powerful reminder of the eternal rewards that come from embracing and surrendering to Allah's will, making it a deeply meaningful and inspiring name for Muslims.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Favor, Blessing, Satisfaction" symbolizes One who is content with the decree of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ridwaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of favor, blessing, satisfaction.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah - Volume 2, Chapter 14: The Caliphate of 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab (r.a.), Section: The Battles of 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab (r.a.) - The Conquest of Egypt - The Peace Treaty with Caesar - The Battle of Mu'tah. In this section, there is mentioned the martyrdom of 'Amr ibn Al-'Aas (r.a.), who was the Governor of Egypt at that time and took the name Ridwaan before his death.
historical_references.context: During the early Islamic conquests under the caliphate of 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab (r.a.), 'Amr ibn Al-'Aas (r.a.) was the Governor of Egypt. He took the name Ridwaan before his death during the Battle of Mu'tah, which took place between 634 AD and 636 AD.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hisham's Sirat Rasul Allah - Biography of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) - Volume 3: The Conquest of Egypt - The Battle of Mu'tah. In this section, the name Ridwaan is mentioned in relation to 'Amr ibn Al-'Aas (r.a.), who was the Governor of Egypt at the time and took the name before his martyrdom.
historical_references.context: During the early Islamic conquests under the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), 'Amr ibn Al-'Aas (r.a.) was the Governor of Egypt. He took the name Ridwaan before his death during the Battle of Mu'tah, which took place between 634 AD and 636 AD.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic name 'Ridwaan' is gaining popularity in modern contexts, reflecting the evolving identities of Muslims around the world. Ridwaan is derived from the Arabic word 'Ridha' meaning 'contentment' or 'pleased'. This name holds significant spiritual meaning for Muslims, representing the feeling of being in the presence of Allah and being content with His will. In the modern context, the name Ridwaan is seen on various platforms including social media, educational websites, and marriage platforms. On social media, users with this name are active in communities focused on Islamic spirituality and personal growth. Educational websites catering to Muslim students often feature the name Ridwaan in their databases and user interfaces. Lastly, on marriage platforms, the name Ridwaan is sometimes given as a preference by parents for their children or sought out by potential spouses as a desirable name. Overall, the use of the Islamic name Ridwaan highlights the importance of spiritual identity and contentment within the Muslim community, while adapting to modern trends and technologies.
